rows.note: Use 郊遊 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a short recreational outing, especially one into the countryside.

example.english: We’re going on an excursion this Sunday and will eat something in the countryside.
example.traditional: 今個星期日我哋去郊遊，順便喺郊外食吓嘢。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gaau1 jau4 seon6 bin2 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 sik6 haa5 je5

rows.note: Use 實地考察 for an organized educational or research trip to study something on location.

example.english: The students will go on an excursion to the wetland park next week to study it on site.
example.traditional: 學生下星期會去濕地公園做實地考察。
example.jyutping: hok6 saang1 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 heoi3 sap1 dei6 gung1 jyun4 zou6 sat6 dei6 haau2 caat3

rows.note: Use 題外話 when the excursion is a side remark or digression from the main subject.

example.english: Speaking of housing prices, that’s an excursion from our main topic, so let’s get back to today’s agenda.
example.traditional: 講開樓價，呢個係題外話，我哋先返去今日嘅議題。
example.jyutping: gong2 hoi1 lau4 gaa3 ni1 go3 hai6 tai4 ngoi6 waa6 ngo5 dei6 sin1 faan1 heoi3 gam1 jat6 ge3 ji5 tai4
